## Problem Statement

A clear description of the problem you want to solve.
Example: "I'm always frustrated when..."

## Proposed Solution

A clear description of what you'd like to happen.

## Alternatives Considered

Any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Use Case

How would this feature be used? Who would benefit from it?

## Area

- [ ] Editor UI / UX
- [ ] Components
- [ ] Visual scripting (`.px` graphs)
- [ ] Rendering
- [ ] Physics / collision
- [ ] Resources, projects, persistence
- [ ] Preview / export
- [ ] Performance
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Something else

## Additional Context

Add any mockups, technical notes, references, or additional context here.
